scope: WP-CAP-BOTS BotsPage source-baseline result-shape and filesystem-read hardening

boundedDefect.before: runExecute dereferenced wrong-shaped but valid JSON through testResults.flatMap, assertionResults.map, and testcase fields before assembling structured process evidence; parseResultsFile also read outside its parse try/catch.
boundedDefect.risk: The runner failed closed through an escaped TypeError/read error, but lost structured diagnostics and the assembled execution report.
boundedDefect.after: parseResultsFile returns a distinct filesystem-read or JSON-parse diagnostic, and runExecute passes parsed JSON through the pure normalizeResultCases boundary before evaluation/classification.

diagnosticDomains.resultsReadError: Filesystem read failed after the results path was found; retains message, code, and path.
diagnosticDomains.resultsParseError: Bytes were read but JSON.parse failed; retains message, path, and byte length.
diagnosticDomains.resultSchemaError: JSON parsed but the test-results structure was missing, null, or wrong-shaped; retains the first reason and type/value detail.
diagnosticDomains.missingFile: No result and no read/parse/schema diagnostic; classification still setup_block because no results exist.

failClosedShapes: null or non-object testResults file entry
missing, null, non-string, or empty case status
normalization.evidencePreservation: Readable case objects are retained with raw fields/status; unreadable null cases use a safe placeholder; raw counts and spawn evidence remain separate from classification.
normalization.classification: Any resultsReadError, resultsParseError, or resultSchemaError is setup_block before completed-source classification.

controls.validFailing: Complete clean assertion failure remains source_behavioral_failure, never GREEN.
controls.priorConservativeRegressions: Signal, ETIMEDOUT, spawn error, pending/todo, null/missing exit, count mismatch, case mismatch, and root's full 8/6/2 blocking matrix remain covered.
controls.intentionalAssertionCorrection: The prior unit expectation that a missing case status had no schema error was corrected; its setup_block behavior and preserved raw case were unchanged.

verification.preflightCountQualification: Corroborating spot check only; throwaway fixtures and imported pure helpers are the isolated proof.

modelEvidence.source: Prior Orca worker-start receipt for the exact reused live session
